result.summary: FINDINGS at target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895 (feature/binary-config-serve-20260930), scope: idle/busy detection, absent session status, interrupted assistant messages, false completion. Reviewed src/providers/opencode.ts (inspect/sessionStatus/inference_active) and src/coordinator.ts (monitor settle gate, step catch-path recovery, fallback/complete, token-idle) at exact target in a disposable /tmp clone; /workspace/repo left clean at baseline 5672ead. 2 findings, both reproduced: (1) MEDIUM src/coordinator.ts:519-525 - any throw out of the running/waiting pass completes the run from result.json with no idle evidence, bypassing the documented 'settles only on reported idle' guard at :560/:603-609; repro shows completed + 'written mid-turn' while the session is busy streaming, and the worker is then terminal. (2) LOW src/coordinator.ts:627-634 - a lost turn (session absent with an unfinished assistant message) is recorded as waiting with error null and a 'partial' excerpt, explained only 300s later as 'No token progress'. The branch delta touches none of these files, so both pre-date it. Artifacts: /workspace/.swarmforge/artifacts/review.md, findings.json; logs under /workspace/.swarmforge/logs.
result.details:
FINDINGS at exact target d428e0f730ed5649485732e95d39c32f5d6a8895; verdict FINDINGS (1 MEDIUM, 1 LOW), both reproduced with the repo's own injected doubles (no real providers, VMs or models).

F1 MEDIUM - src/coordinator.ts:519-525: the step() catch path calls fallback()+complete() for running/waiting workers after any throw (30s bounded()/AbortSignal.timeout on every OpenCode request at src/providers/opencode.ts:68-74, connection reset during the OpenCode unit's Restart=on-failure at src/providers/freestyle.ts:173, 4xx/5xx from /session/status or /session/messages with throwOnError:true, or a Freestyle getWorker error at :487). It never polls status, so it contradicts the invariant documented at :556-560 and enforced at :560 and :603-609. fallback() only matches run_id/worker_id (:685-686), so a result.json written mid-turn is indistinguishable from the final one. Consequence: stored completed, branch pushed and remote-verified with persisted=true under github-app/ssh (:693-704) or completed with no push under the default SWARMFORGE_GIT_PUSH_MODE=none (src/config.ts:50-52), while the session may still be generating; the worker becomes terminal so later text, usage and commits are never collected. Reproduction: /tmp/opencode/rev29/probe/probe-a.test.ts (state completed, result 'written mid-turn', snapshot busy with an incomplete assistant message) and probe-b.test.ts case C (stays completed after the probe recovers, gauge cleared). Guards: tests/session-status.test.ts:234 and :257 assert this guard for the monitor path only; tests/lifecycle.test.ts:212 codifies the opposite intent for the error path but only with a genuinely final file; no test combines a thrown inspect with a mid-turn file, and no warning marks the completion unconfirmed. Fix: re-poll status once in the catch path and complete only on idle, or require the last observed snapshot to have been settled, or at minimum attach a warnings entry naming the unconfirmed completion.

F2 LOW - src/coordinator.ts:627-634 with :603-609 and :620-623: when the session disappears from /session/status (restart, abort, resume after pause) while the last assistant message has no time.completed (src/providers/opencode.ts:140,162-164 -> inference_active 1), the worker is recorded as waiting with error null (only status retry produces text) and the stranded excerpt is labelled 'RESPONSE partial' (src/cli/overview.ts:246), identical to a live turn; the only later signal 300s later is 'No token progress for 300s; worker quiesced', which never mentions the lost session. Reproduction: probe-b.test.ts case B (waiting, error null, excerpt_partial true). inference_active is computed per snapshot but used only for the metric gauge (:542, src/metrics.ts:80) and docs/OBSERVABILITY.md:17 documents it as an estimate. Fix: when settled is true but the newest reply is incomplete, record a distinct error naming the vanished session/unfinished message and mark the excerpt stranded.

Verified-clean checks (recorded to avoid re-review): sessionStatus maps exactly the SDK 1.18.31 SessionStatus union (idle|retry|busy), so its unknown branch is defensive; absent-session idle is the intended tested shape; dispatch message_id is unique (src/store.ts:28,217) so stale replies cannot match a new dispatch; resume shifts token_progress_at by the paused duration (:866-868); a failed status poll is not a no-progress observation (tests/token-idle.test.ts:139-153); getWorker returns null only on 404 (src/providers/freestyle.ts:88-95). Delta note: baseline 5672ead -> target changes none of the reviewed files (src/providers/opencode.ts and src/domain.ts byte-identical), so both findings pre-date the branch. Experiments live only in /tmp/opencode/rev29/probe. Artifacts sanitized with the production Redactor (src/security.ts:3-23); no credentials present.

Finding 1 is partially codified as intended behavior by tests/lifecycle.test.ts:212 (recovering structured output from a result file after an OpenCode failure); the finding is the missing settle/idle check and missing warning in that recovery path, not the recovery itself.
The absent-session-idle premise could not be confirmed against a live OpenCode 1.18.31 server; it is taken from src/providers/opencode.ts:177-182 and the repository's own tests.

An over-broad canary list was used in one first Redactor pass over the artifacts and replaced the substring 'token' in identifiers such as token-idle.test.ts; this was repaired and both artifacts were re-verified (0 redaction markers, 0 credential-shaped URLs, findings.json parses).
result.followup_reason: Two actionable findings in the idle/false-completion path: (1) MEDIUM src/coordinator.ts:519-525 completes a run from a result file after any inspect/provider throw, with no idle evidence, bypassing the settle guard at :560/:603-609 (reproduced); (2) LOW src/coordinator.ts:627-634 reports a lost turn as a silent waiting worker with a 'partial' excerpt and only a generic token-idle failure 300s later (reproduced). Both need a coordinator fix plus regression tests covering a thrown inspect with a mid-turn result file, and a diagnosis when status is idle while the newest assistant message is incomplete.
